segments.subgoal: Explain the tracking process stages using IMU sensors as a practical case study.
Describe the components and primary functions of IMU sensors in tracking.
Explain the calibration process for mapping cheap sensor readings to accurate values using linear least squares.
Describe how the registration stage sets the initial alignment between the real and virtual worlds.
Explain how the integration stage computes orientation over time by summing calibrated angular velocity samples.
Describe how the drift correction stage combines multiple sensor values using a gain parameter to correct orientation errors.
Summarize the four stages of the tracking process: calibration, registration, integration, and drift correction.
Summarize the main points of the lecture.
